column14: Please make a copy to your Drive for extended use.

Damping ratio calculations (ζ) are made under the assumption Forza's damping units are n/mm/s. It's likely this is incorrect, and possible that Forza uses coefficient scaling by weight, and/or scaling brackets by weight and/or class.
ζ: In most cases, no less than 50% bump, no more than 80% rebound. 55% bump, 65% rebound is a safe starting point.
Hz: 2.0-3.0Hz for road cars, below 2.0Hz for some rally cars and offroad (Horizon), above 3.0Hz for some race cars.
